LESSON: POULTRY REARING IN A FOLD

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Poultry Rearing in a Fold
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 11

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Poultry Rearing in a Fold, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How can we rear poultry in a fold for food production?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Poultry Rearing in a Fold together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Unity: The learners collaborate and demonstrate teamwork while working in groups to construct a poultry fold.

• Responsibility: The learner observes safety precautions while using objects with sharp edges (wires, plastic and wood) to construct a

poultry fold.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Environmental education and climate change: The learner reuses and recycles locally available materials to construct poultry fold.

• Safety and Security: The learners observe safety for self and others as they use tools and equipment to construct poultry fold.

Link to other subjects:

• Learners relate dimensions of a poultry fold to measurements in Mathematics.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Signs Language Dictionary

• Digital devices

• Materials for construction a fold such as recycled wood and wires

• Tools

• Chicken feeds

• Feeders

• Waterers
